description: Ministry of Labour - The Industrial Dispute between Mrs. N. P, Madarasinghe Thalahena Malabe & Other Part Ceylon Petroleum Storage Ltd. Kolonnawa - The Industrial Dispute between K. A. G. Ariyasinghe Aluthgama Watta, Yakkala (S & E Only)
categorisation: This gazette content involves the exercise of statutory powers under the Industrial Disputes Act (Chapter 131) to appoint arbitrators for industrial disputes. It contains legal orders made by the Minister of Labour under specific legislative authority, making it primarily about legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
